subtopics.title: Advanced User Authentication with Django
subtopics.description: Explore advanced techniques for user authentication in Django, including custom authentication backends, social authentication, and multi-factor authentication. Understand how to secure user accounts and manage authentication states effectively.

subtopics.title: Optimizing Form Handling and Validation in Django
subtopics.description: Delve into advanced form handling and validation techniques in Django, including custom form classes, formsets, form validation strategies, and form rendering options. Learn how to create efficient and user-friendly forms that adhere to best practices.
